formal_statement: ∃ L : Submodule ℂ (Fin 4 × Fin 4 → ℂ), Module.finrank ℂ L = 3 ∧ (∀ t ∈ L, ∀ i j : Fin 4, t (i, j) = t (j, i)) ∧ ∀ t ∈ L, Matrix.permanent (Matrix.of fun (i j : Fin 4) => (1 : ℂ) + t (i, j)) = 24
plain_statement: There is a 3-dimensional linear space L of 4 x 4 complex matrices, each symmetric (t(i, j) = t(j, i)), such that for every t in L the permanent of the matrix with entries 1 + t(i, j) equals 24, its value at t = 0. Conjecture; the symmetric level spaces found by search have dimension at most 2 (computed, not checked).
title: Probe: a three-dimensional space of 4 x 4 complex symmetric matrices keeps the permanent of the all-ones matrix plus it at 24
